We present the next Alchemist: The Potion Monger update! It's centered around improving the gamepad support and modifying the UI to work better with it.
As always seasoned with a handful of bug fixes!
Many UI panels and the Almanac were tweaked to work better with the gamepad. You'll no longer feel that you're playing the keyboard and mouse game with your controller.
Now all gamepad users' experience will be enhanced with the vibrations, accompanying them while using the tools, brewing potions, interacting with the game world, using potions, and many more!
We improved interaction with small objects such as Red Eyes, Flies, etc. while using the gamepad. No more testing your nerves and reflexes while trying to interact with them!
Weapons no longer glow in the dark
Japanese language unresponsive UI fixed
Red-eyes no longer die when sleeping during the mission
Contracts no longer fail to load when loading old save files
Fixed issues with drawing distance
Fixed issues with the emission on the lamps at night
You guys are amazing!
Happy Brewing <3

We present the next Alchemist: The Potion Monger heavy bug-fixing update! It contains a slight rework of the player market stall and a new skill to highlight it.
Welcome Patch #8 - Know your Customer and destroy bugs!
Thanks for reporting that many bugs (as always especially to @Waffles from our Discord), this won't be possible by ourselves.

We have reworked a player stall potion selling system by adding the new skill - Know your Customer. After completing its related task, it allows you to see what prices for what potion are appropriate based on the color scheme. Light Green - very easy to sell, to Dark Red - very hard to sell.
Visit the fellow brew seller - the Bartender to learn more!

All the trade-related skills and potions have been reworked to work with the new system, which means they no longer grant you bonus gold but increase the probability of buying for your set price instead!

We proudly present the third step of our Road Map - the fifth and so far the biggest Alchemist: The Potion Monger patch - The Christmas and Priest Update.
It brings loads of new content and is the first patch to include a new Character, Quest, Potions, and Animal!

notes.title: New face on the Island - Peter, The Towns Priest!

items.text: Ever wondered why the Towns got a church but did not have a priest? You'll find answers in this update.
Let us welcome Peter, the rumored brother of Pablo the Mayor back from the pilgrimage to the Golden Trough. He'll appear once you reach reputation level 4!
Help Peter appease the Golden Hog using a brand new potion (and a bunch of old ones) and gain a new skill, as well as a new potion recipe!
Ever wanted to be an alchemical shepherd? You did not? erm... Now you can! Buy your own sheep (or acquire them in some other way...) and start shaving them for the new alchemical ingredient - Wool!
Learn the recipes for 3 new potions. We're not going to spoil anything for you here find them out by yourself. ask Peter about them

It's finally that time of the year! Feel the Xmas spirit walking around the decorated Town market and find snowmen in the Winterlands. Don't forget to purchase a Christmas Tree from Peter, for the Santa Pig to lay gifts under! Check it every day till the 5th of January.
Fixed audio effects of some potions duplicating themselves
Corner Shelf placing fixed
Fixed some quests to block themselves when the player performs certain actions too early
Thunder sound added to the Lightning Potion
Fixed grass disappearing in the Hunter region
Fixed indefinitely cow milking bug
Fixed "Snake Nuggets" achievement not registering properly for some players
With this update, we continue our Road Map patches cycle, new ones coming every 2/3 weeks
Stay tuned!
As always, many thanks for your feedback on Discord as well as on Steam Discussions.
Happy Brewing <3
AGS Team

We present the second step of our Road Map - the fourth Alchemist: The Potion Monger patch - The Storage Update, this time on Tuesday.
It will greatly refine the quality of your alchemical life by improving the interface, map, and Almanac.
Here is what's new!
Now you can reach your favorite things in your Book way easier. Potion recipes and Automatic Potions are now sorted by name, it is also possible to find them in the new dedicated search field!
It's now also way easier to click on the pins, their colliders now take half of the bar.
You can find symbols in the top right corner of the page indicating the bookmark you are on.
After you find the Ingredient, its location will appear on the map (not including the plants appearing all around the Island), helping you find the things you need that you previously encountered.
You can also find out your character rotation regarding the map, thanks to the new player's marker.
Alchemical Ingredients now have a better 3D interface showing their Aspects (similar to that of discovering them).
The spoon in the cauldron should no longer get in the way of the bubbles that often (it will be always on your right side)
Better settings window
Almanac is now easier to navigate on the gamepad
Solid state of matter no longer has a stone symbol (was a bit misleading)
New Town fountain look
Chest stack moving bug fixed
Fixed effects of some potions not appearing (Holly Nuke, Unholy Nuke, and more...)
Prettier trees trunks
Better-looking Towns buildings
Ingredients in the Almanac now show their descriptions properly
Fixed the bug in the MY HEARTIES quest
HERB COMPENDIUM - ... loading bug fixed
Screen resolutions are no longer doubled (for some even tripled) in the settings
X and OK symbols are now in appropriate colors
Fixed infinite Diamonds in the bandit's chest
New effect when creating the automatic potions
Furniture now can be dropped
Contracts now display the time left
With this update, we continue our Road Map patches cycle, new ones coming every 2/3 weeks
Stay tuned!
As always, many thanks for your feedback on Discord as well as on Steam Discussions.
Happy Brewing <3
AGS Team
We present the first step of our Road Map - the third Alchemist: The Potion Monger patch - The Storage Update.
It will greatly improve your home/lab experience as well as include requested fixes and additions.
Take a look!

notes.title: Chests are now available for purchase!

items.text: You can now visit the Furniture Seller to buy 3 Chests (4 Chests total!) for your storage needs. They are not cheap but they will greatly improve your hoarding capabilities!

notes.title: More freedom in placing the furniture!

items.text: Place your furnishing however you like, from now on, even outside your house. Some items previously limited to table placement can be now placed on the ground, and vice versa.

notes.title: Reposition your shelves with items on!

items.text: We know how frustrating moving the shelves was, and that's why we implemented the function to reposition them with your items!
Cows now spawn flies
Cloud Save is now fully functional
Road Map can now be accessed from the game's Main Menu
The Cave in the Farmlands is now a little easier to get through
Contract value and reputation gain should now appear properly in the Almanac in every language
The Cure quest bugs fixed
Red-eyed spawns fixed
Women now dance when affected by the Danse Macabre Potion
Chest in the Bandits Camp now has better, more shiny loot
Optimized picking up great numbers of items from the shelves
New context menu for picking items from shelves
No more pink effects on the Stove
You can now purchase potion recipes and skills with the full inventory
Foxes no more wag their tails when dead
Picked-up recipes and skill books no longer respawn after some time
Skeletons now play proper sound effects when hit and when dying
Furniture can now be placed in the corners behind doors
Picking from shelves on the gamepad no longer causes one to pick up the whole shelf
With this update, we start our Road Map patches cycle, the next ones coming every 2/3 weeks.
Stay tuned!
As always, many thanks for your feedback on Discord as well as on Steam Discussions.
Happy Brewing <3
AGS Team
It's witching hour!
We present to you the second Alchemist: The Potion Monger patch.
Have a happy Halloween everyone! On this occasion, we've prepared a themed game addition, as well as, bug fixes and more things for you to enjoy.
Immerse yourself in the spooky climate of All Hallows' Eve, thanks to the new festive decorations.

notes.title: New festive decoration for your home!

items.text: Visit the Greengrocer on the Towns square to purchase the new Halloween decoration - Jack-o-lantern. Place up to 6 of these mean, animated, music-playing fellows in your home and celebrate!
P.S. Save some money because they are not cheap, but worth every penny, and Halloween-limited.

Fly, Rotten Meat, Animal Excrement, Rotten Milk, Warmshroom, Papaj Shroom, Lotus, Many Eyes, Devils Fruit and Diamond.

The dog will no longer move characters when talking with them.

Added music to the boss fights.
